_about: Joseph Clark Hoppin (1870-1925), Bryn Mawr archaeologist: A Handbook of Attic Red-Figured Vases Signed by or Attributed to the Various Masters (2 vols., 1919) and Euthymides and his Fellows (1917). Vol. II is catalogue-heavy with Greek inscriptions; kept per Adam's 2026-10-23 ruling. Classical scholarship (lane B, round de). Raw IA OCR unless a Gutenberg text is named. No uids minted.  Round ea adds his Handbook of Greek Black-Figured Vases (1924).
